name: Conceptual: minimum T/W wing loading for the Gudmundsson Ex. 3-1 brief
notes: Single variable W/S; the stall limit (ADRpy wsmaxcleanstall_pa from vstallclean_kcas and CLmaxclean) is an explicit constraint.
Aspect ratio is NOT a variable: without a wing-weight model ADRpy constraints always favour the largest AR (see DECISIONS.md D-07).
